facility.name: Kids R Kids #60
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: One of the designated drivers for the operation did not have their current 2 clock hours of annual transportation safety training. The staff member's most recent transportation safety training on file was dated 01/13/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The loose-fill surfacing material on the playground for toddlers was not at the required depth of six inches based on the highest designated play surface or five feet or less.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: During investigation inspection, director could not provide infant feeding instruction sheets for one infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: An unsupervised child in care was able to exit the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: Fire extinguishers were not checked for the month of April 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: During inspection, one caregiver was observed not talking to the children in a positive way during lunch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: One child did not have immunizations on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months: Caregiver was observed feeding two infants bottles while in bouncers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months (26 TAC §746.2419(1))

occurrences.finding: Medication Records - Name of Employee Who Administered: Medication log did not have staff who administered medications full name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Records - Name of Employee Who Administered (26 TAC §746.3805(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Fire Drill for the month of April 2025 was not conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: One child did not have physician or hospital information documented on admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During inspection, one of the playgrounds observed had a loose screw for barrier that keeps loose fill on play structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: Two children's medication expired October 2024 and March 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One child did not have current immunization on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: Four medications reviewed were not in original container.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on video footage received caregiver was unaware a child was left in the classroom closet for 3 to 4 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you contract with someone who requires a background check: Two people who are contracted  to provide extra curricular activities for students were present supervising children outside on a see-through bus without background checks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you contract with someone who requires a background check (26 TAC §745.621(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on information gathered during investigation and from inspection conducted staff was observed rejecting and yelling at the children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on information provided visual supervision was not maintained for children who were behaving inappropriately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on video footage received, four children were left unattended while caregiver was in the restroom with another child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Based on documents received, incident report was not signed by parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Setting: During inspection, Operational Policies did not state in which setting physical activity will be held.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Setting (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(D))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parent Participation: During inspection, Operational Policies did not provide procedures for parents to participate in the operations activities during school hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies Procedures for Parent Review Licensing Reports & How to Access Rules (26 TAC §746.501(a)(22))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Duration: During inspection, Operational Policies were missing how long the child should be outside during outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Duration (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(B))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: During inspection, Operational Policies did not have Parents Rights listed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: During inspection, Operational Policies did not state how operation will support inclusive services to children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Benefits: During inspection, Operational Policies were missing the benefits of outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Benefits (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website: During inspection, Operational Policies did not have procedures on how parents can access minimum standards online. Operational Policies had DFPS website but did not have HHSC website in policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website (26 TAC §746.501(a)(23))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather: During inspection, Operational Policies did not state how the operation defines extreme weather for when children can and cannot go outside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(F))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Type of Physical Activity: During inspection, Operational Policies were missing the type of outdoor physical activity the children will engage in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Type of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(C))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Plan for extreme weather conditions: During inspection, Operational Policies did not explain how operation plans to continue outdoor physical activity when extreme weather conditions occur.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Plan for extreme weather conditions (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(G))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: During inspection, children with birth dates 4/30/2022, 11/9/2020, 2/6/2023, and 6/22/2020 did not have current immunization record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Based on CPR training card provided. One out of the two reviewed conducted CPR training online.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation there is sufficient evidence to prove that although the caregiver was in close proximity of the children, the caregiver did not intervene to remove the children from standing on the table, which resulted in a child pushing another child off of the table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support that the caregiver was not using good judgement by allowing children to climb on the tables.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation. Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support the allegation of neglectful supervision by a caregiver causing a child to receive an injury that required medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on video footage, infants were not being removed from play equipment properly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Physical Activity including Supervised Tummy Time and Safe, Clean, Uncluttered Area: Based on video footage, activities such as tummy time was not observed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Physical Activity including Supervised Tummy Time and Safe, Clean, Uncluttered Area (26 TAC §746.2417(3))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: Validation of employee list was conducted on 12/14/2022.    Noted: Director validated people list during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))
